screenplay: LITTLE WITNESSES: EPISODE 1: THE SMALLEST LUNCH

hero_prop_criteria.center_of_focus: The story, a shot or a character's attention centres on the object.
hero_prop_criteria.high_frequency: The object is present in more than one scene/act.
hero_prop_criteria.transfer: The object passes between two characters.
hero_prop_criteria.actively_handled: A character physically interacts with the object (holds, uses, repairs...).

hero_props.name: Yonah’s five barley loaves and two fish
hero_props.description: Yonah’s small lunch: five barley loaves and two fish. In Jesus’s hands it multiplies into bread, fish, pieces, and leftovers; treated as one prop/set through its miraculous change in quantity.
hero_props.reason: This is the central biblical miracle prop, repeatedly handled, transferred from Yonah to Andrew to Jesus, multiplied, distributed, eaten, and gathered as leftovers.
